name: golden_low_sunward
lua: game.Lighting:SetAttribute("WeatherBase", "Calm") game.Lighting.ClockTime = 17.3 local c = workspace.CurrentCamera c.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable local p = Vector3.new(600,7,-600) local d = game.Lighting:GetSunDirection() local f = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Unit local pitch = -0.03 c.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p, p + f * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(pitch), 0)) workspace:SetAttribute("ShotCF", workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)

name: night_moon
lua: game.Lighting:SetAttribute("WeatherBase", "Clear") game.Lighting.ClockTime = 22.5 local c = workspace.CurrentCamera c.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable local p = Vector3.new(600,8,-600) local d = game.Lighting:GetMoonDirection() local f = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Unit local pitch = math.clamp(math.asin(d.Y) - 0.42, -0.2, 0.25) c.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p, p + f * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(pitch), 0)) workspace:SetAttribute("ShotCF", workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
